title: Decontextualization, Everywhere: A Systematic Audit on PeerQA

contributions.purpose: 系统审计去上下文化策略在科学 QA 检索中的作用
contributions.mechanism: 跨检索族(BM25/TF-IDF/dense/ColBERT/cross-encoder)×粒度(句/段)×5 模板扫描 PeerQA,报 Recall@k/MRR/answerability F1
contributions.evaluation: 579 QA / 90 篇论文;发现去上下文化非一刀切:oracle 下 sparse 偏 minimal,full-corpus 下段级 title+heading 最佳
contributions.domain: 科学长文档 QA / 信息检索
contributions.source_quote: A systematic audit of decontextualization across retrieval families (sparse, dense, late interaction) and granularities (sentence, paragraph) on PeerQA with author-verified evidence.

contributions.purpose: 揭示 oracle 评测严重高估检索效果
contributions.mechanism: 对比 per-paper 索引(oracle)与全语料检索
contributions.evaluation: BM25 oracle R@10=1.000/MRR=0.679(270 chunks)vs full-corpus R@10=0.011/MRR=0.015(24,265 chunks),约 90× 难
contributions.source_quote: oracle-style evaluation (per-paper indexing) dramatically inflates retrieval scores compared to full-corpus search

contributions.purpose: 揭示检索与下游 answerability 解耦
contributions.mechanism: 把检索输出传入 answerability 分类,计算相关性
contributions.evaluation: full-corpus Dense F1=0.718 反超 oracle BM25 0.713(尽管召回差 100×);R@10 与 F1 相关仅 0.014(full corpus)
contributions.source_quote: answerability F1 exhibits only weak correlation with retrieval quality, motivating evaluation beyond retrieval metrics.

contributions.purpose: 提供可复现的扫描框架与实践指南
contributions.mechanism: 可配置框架扫模板/粒度、建索引、报 oracle 与 full-corpus 双制度指标
contributions.evaluation: 指南:先做论文识别、段级 chunk、measured 去上下文化、端到端 full-corpus 评测
contributions.source_quote: A configurable framework that sweeps templates and granularities, builds indexes, and reports retrieval (Recall@k, MRR) and answerability (F1) in both oracle and full-corpus regimes.

self_declared_provenance.quote: A central, recurring observation in this domain is that decontextualization—augmenting passages with structural cues such as the paper title or the most recent section heading—can improve retrieval. Yet, despite its growing use, we lack a systematic understanding of when, how, and to what extent decontextualization helps
we operationalize these insights in a controlled audit over scientific peer-review QA to provide dataset-native guidance on decontextualization across retriever families and granularities.

notes: 自声明 5 条贡献(此处并'实践指南'入 C4)。本批质量最高的一篇(accept):核心即两条方法学负/警示结果——oracle 评测虚高(90× 差距,使'论文识别'成瓶颈)、检索质量与下游 answerability 几乎不相关(R@10 vs F1 相关 0.014)。表格数字大体自洽:Table 5 比值行 '90×/91×/45×' 与 24265/270≈90、1.000/0.011≈91、0.679/0.015≈45 对得上(标注稍乱但可核)。轻度红旗:(1)oracle BM25 段级 R@10 对所有问题恰为完美 1.000,270 chunks 内 top-10 全中略可疑(疑 qrels 泄漏/评测设定过易),论文自认是 per-paper 缩小搜索空间所致。(2)与外部基线对比错位:prior PeerQA BM25 R@10=0.6388,而'Ours oracle'BM25=1.000,因'oracle'定义为 per-paper 索引(更易),非同一设定;作者已声明。(3)全 AI 生成:Claude Opus 写代码、GPT-5 写论文,AI Involvement 全 [C]。(4)AI 生成文本瑕疵:Related Work 结尾出现重复断句'...across retriever families and granularities.tive guidance on decontextualization best practices across retriever families and granularities.'(复制粘贴痕迹)。诚实披露:Checklist Q7 statistical significance [No]('not heavily influenced by randomness')、Q8 compute [No] 但给 GPU RAM≈1980MiB;AI 限制 Q5 自认'models can generate inaccurate claims in writing'需人工核验。未见造数/占位图/破坏双盲等硬红旗。
